title: A kinetic ruler controls mRNA poly(A) tail length
authors: Gabs E; Aalto-Setälä E; Välisaari A; Malinen AM; Jensen TH; McLaughlin SH; Passmore LA; Turtola M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母Nab2蛋白调控mRNA poly(A)尾长度的动力学机制，虽涉及RNA结合蛋白与核酸互作，但对象为RNA而非DNA，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关系微弱。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Poly(A) tails of newly synthesized mRNAs have uniform lengths, arising through cooperation between the cleavage and polyadenylation complex (CPAC) and poly(A) binding proteins (PABPs). In the budding yeast, Saccharomyces cerevisiae , the responsible PABP is the evolutionarily conserved CCCH zinc finger protein Nab2 that facilitates the biogenesis of ∼60 adenosine mRNA poly(A) tails. Here, we address the molecular basis for such length control. Reconstituting polyadenylation reactions during the formation of Nab2:poly(A) RNA ribonucleoprotein particles in vitro , we find that Nab2 dimerization directs polyadenylation termination. The Nab2 dimer is stable only on poly(A) tails that are longer than 25 adenosines, explaining how Nab2 avoids prematurely terminating poly(A) synthesis. However, the mature tail length is not determined by the footprint of Nab2 on the RNA, but rather by the kinetic competition between CPAC-mediated tail elongation and Nab2 RNA-binding. Variations in Nab2 RNA-binding rate can shift poly(A) tail lengths, but in cells such variations are buffered by autoregulation of Nab2 protein concentration. As a result, poly(A) tail length control operates through a “kinetic ruler” mechanism, whereby the concentration of Nab2 quantifies RNA length.
abstract_zh:
摘要

新合成mRNA的poly(A)尾具有均匀长度，这是通过切割与多聚腺苷酸化复合物（CPAC）和poly(A)结合蛋白（PABPs）之间的协作实现的。在芽殖酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中，负责此过程的PABP是进化上保守的CCCH锌指蛋白Nab2，它促进约60个腺苷的mRNA poly(A)尾的生物发生。在此，我们探讨这种长度控制的分子基础。通过在体外重建Nab2:poly(A) RNA核糖核蛋白颗粒形成过程中的多聚腺苷酸化反应，我们发现Nab2二聚化指导多聚腺苷酸化的终止。Nab2二聚体仅在长于25个腺苷的poly(A)尾上稳定，这解释了Nab2如何避免过早终止poly(A)合成。然而，成熟尾长并非由Nab2在RNA上的足迹决定，而是由CPAC介导的尾延伸与Nab2 RNA结合之间的动力学竞争决定。Nab2 RNA结合速率的变化可改变poly(A)尾长度，但在细胞中，这种变化通过Nab2蛋白浓度的自身调控得到缓冲。因此，poly(A)尾长度控制通过“动力学标尺”机制运作，其中Nab2的浓度量化RNA长度。
